name: Corporación Interamericana de Entretenimiento, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: Corporación Interamericana de Entretenimiento, S.A.B. de C.V. operates in the out-of-home entertainment industry in Mexico, Brazil, and Colombia. The company provides a range of entertainment options, including concerts, theatrical productions, sporting events, family and cultural events, and others. In addition, the company produces and promotes concerts, music festivals, Broadway and urban content, sporting, family and corporate events.
